orientation: A.3 is where Sky defines what it means to be solvent: the Risk Capital framework that prices every exposure, the Surplus Buffer and Smart Burn Engine that recycle revenue, and the loss-absorption waterfall ending in a pre-committed peg cut paired with a fixed SKY airdrop. It is also the most formula-dense material in the Atlas, and therefore where the extraction found the most apparent defects — bounds that evaluate the wrong way, caps that make whole risk bands unreachable, and reference code that disagrees with its own specification.
